title: No injury found on man who died in custody
article: There was no evidence of injury or trauma in an autopsy of a man who died in police custody last weekend, a police official said Tuesday.
Toxicology tests are being conducted to determine what killed 30- year-old Richard Perry Bellerose. The tests are expected to take two or three months.
Bellerose was confronted by Marty and Michelle Chan in their house near 106th Avenue and 75th Street. Marty Chan overpowered Bellerose outside the house.
A couple of minutes later police arrived and arrested Bellerose, who then began showing signs of physical distress. Bellerose was taken to hospital, where he died.
